title: The Ball That Would Not Fly Straight
coreQuestion: Why was the 2010 Jabulani ball criticised for its flight?

facts.claim: The Jabulani was the official match ball of the 2010 FIFA World Cup.
The ball was made of eight thermally bonded panels.
Players and goalkeepers criticised the ball's flight.
NASA researchers found a knuckleball effect in its flight.

narration.text: The 2010 World Cup ball had goalkeepers worried.
Players complained about how it moved in the air.
NASA researchers tested it, and found a knuckleball effect.
A ball that wobbles instead of flying straight is hard to read.
A ball's surface can change its flight. Every goal has a story.
